translations.web: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.
translations.bsb: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.
translations.kjv: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
